tweet_summary: Right-wing engagement account 'Hunter Eagleman' posts an AI video of a baby strapped into a baby-carrier on the back of a golden retriever, captioned 'My grandson will be trying this soon!'
why_note_decision: The video has multiple AI tells called out in the replies (baby appearing to have only one leg, weird limb geometry, AI-typical motion). The source TikTok creator @madmaikai produces AI content. Several top replies explicitly identify it as AI ('That's the freakiest AI vid I have seen yet', 'Is the baby in the dog, half a baby or just missing a leg??', 'It's AI'). The tweet treats it as real and suggests imitating the practice, which is unsafe to do with a real baby and dog. A note labeling the video AI-generated is warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS if the note clearly states the video is AI-generated and cites at least one indication (creator account known for AI content, visible AI artifacts referenced by replies, or similar AI-disclosed reposts). FAIL if the note (a) treats the video as real, (b) only critiques the safety of carrying a baby on a dog without flagging AI, or (c) declines (this is a clear AI-flagging case where the author is encouraging imitation).
reference_note: This video is AI-generated, not real footage. The clip originates from TikTok creator @madmaikai, an account producing AI-generated animal videos; the baby's anatomy (apparent missing limb, distorted geometry) and motion show typical AI artifacts. Similar AI clips of the same setup are explicitly labeled AI by other reposters. https://www.tiktok.com/@madmaikai/video/7581130738024647958 https://www.instagram.com/reel/DRPf2LNEnGn

original_unhelpful_note.text: The video depicts an AI-generated scene; similar clips explicitly state they use AI with no real baby or dog involved. https://www.tiktok.com/@madmaikai/video/7581130738024647958 https://www.instagram.com/reel/DRPf2LNEnGn
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Note is substantively correct. notNeeded ratings reflect partisan / engagement audience rather than note quality. Treat as helpful_reference.

fact_check.notes: @madmaikai is a known AI content account. Replies on the tweet itself flag classic AI artifacts (missing limb).

importance.lens_rationale: Low-engagement cute-but-fake AI; standalone harm small, but the 'try this at home' framing + AI labeling is exactly the bread-and-butter notewriter case.
